purpose: Continue the full registered-tool affiliate audit with five catalog entries that were not covered by prior audit evidence. This is research-only evidence under the existing audit UUID; it creates no application or duplicate task.

entries.commission: Current headline, How it works section, and FAQ say 35% of referred subscription payments for 12 months
entries.payout_terms: Wise only; payout request requires at least 3 unique paying referrals and a $100 minimum balance; current page says payout normally arrives 2-3 weeks after request and also warns of current payout delays
entries.eligibility: Anyone with a Make account can become an affiliate; the page specifically highlights creators, integration consultants, agencies, thought leaders and freelancers.
entries.evidence_summary: Make's current official affiliate page repeatedly states 35% commission for 12 months, including a dedicated FAQ answer saying the 12-month period begins after affiliate-link registration. However, the same current page's affiliate-vs-partner FAQ separately says affiliates receive commission for 24 months. Because first-party material on one live page conflicts on duration, the audit preserves the conflict and keeps this entry at needs_manual_verification instead of fabricating a single authoritative duration.
entries.legal_consent_note: The page references Affiliate Terms & Conditions for promotional restrictions. No signup or terms acceptance was performed.

entries.commission: Starter tier: 30% recurring commission for up to 1 year on sales; higher tiers retain 30% recurring and may add cost-per-signup or custom commission subject to performance/approval
entries.payout_terms: Impact-managed payouts; current official page states available methods include EFT/direct deposit or PayPal and a $10 minimum balance
entries.eligibility: Official page welcomes software reviewers, content creators, online educators and businesses that integrate with HubSpot; normal application review is stated as 2-3 business days.
entries.evidence_summary: HubSpot's current official affiliate page confirms a free Impact-based program, 30% recurring commission for up to one year, a 180-day cookie and tiered performance rewards. This is distinct from the paid Solutions Partner Program and must not be routed into that paid program.
entries.legal_consent_note: HubSpot's current Affiliate Program Agreement, last modified February 23, 2026, says participation requires agreement to its legally binding terms. No application or agreement acceptance was performed in this audit.

entries.commission: 30% recurring commission for the lifetime of each successful referred subscription, with no commission cap; official page advertises up to $356 per successful referral depending on plan/package
entries.payout_terms: $100 minimum payout; purchases are subject to a 30-day refund policy and the page says payment is made within 30 days after purchase clearance
entries.eligibility: A GetGenie customer subscription is not required to promote it. Signup requires providing the requested information and payout gateway, followed by affiliate-account approval.
entries.evidence_summary: GetGenie's current official English affiliate page confirms a live signup path, 30% lifetime recurring commission, 30-day attribution, a $100 payout threshold and no requirement to be an existing customer. No account creation or application was performed.

entries.commission: 30% per referred sale for 1 year; referred new users receive 20% off for their first 3 months
entries.payout_terms: Dub Partners provides real-time tracking and one-click global payouts; the current public program page does not publish a minimum payout threshold
entries.eligibility: Official launch article explicitly invites influencers, content creators and bloggers through a public application form; existing Dub users can also enroll from the in-app referral dashboard.
entries.evidence_summary: Dub's current official partner page and official launch article confirm an active Dub Partners affiliate program with 30% revenue share for 12 months and a 20% first-three-month customer discount. No application was created because this is the master research audit and future application routing must first deduplicate against account state.

entries.commission: 40% of referred-customer revenue for up to one year while the customer remains subscribed
entries.attribution: Last-touch attribution; clicking a newer affiliate or promo link replaces the earlier attribution
entries.payout_terms: PayPal; payouts one week after each customer payment; a valid PayPal account is required
entries.customer_offer: 10% discount on any Pickaxe plan through the affiliate link
entries.eligibility: Current official page states affiliate earnings accrue only while the affiliate is a paying Pickaxe user. Self-referrals and paid-search bidding on Pickaxe brand terms are prohibited.
entries.evidence_summary: Pickaxe's current official affiliate page confirms an active program, 40% revenue share for up to one year, 7-day last-touch attribution and weekly PayPal payout. Because earning eligibility requires maintaining a paid Pickaxe subscription, this is recorded as cost-gated and is not eligible for the user's zero-cost automatic application path.

dedupe_notes: All five findings are attached to the existing master audit UUID; no new queue UUID was generated.
No affiliate signup, application, account creation, legal terms acceptance, paid subscription, payout setup or production CTA change was performed.
Make.com is held for manual verification because the same current official page conflicts on the commission duration (12 vs 24 months).
Pickaxe is excluded from zero-cost auto-application because current official eligibility requires the affiliate to remain a paying Pickaxe user.
HubSpot affiliate routing must remain separate from the paid Solutions Partner Program.
